fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (35.762459,-95.403211 / 801 N 32nd St) landed in central Muskogee ~9 km NW of the mill. The GP Muskogee tissue mill is a 640-acre complex along the McClellan-Kerr Arkansas River Navigation System, SE of the city. Mill core located via web research + satellite; locked at 35.7345,-95.2985.
fieldNotes.truckGate: POSITIVELY CONFIRMED in Street View (Oct 2024): main entrance driveway off the public road with a 'Georgia-Pacific Muskogee Mill' sign and a chain-link perimeter fence. Controlled entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: POSITIVELY CONFIRMED in Street View: a small gate-house / guard booth structure straddles the entrance road at the main gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false — a manned guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Very large 640-acre campus: pulp/paper machines, recovery boilers, multiple converting plants, multiple finished-goods warehouses, ash landfill, wastewater treatment ponds.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run into the property; rail line visible alongside internal roads and the mill core.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large curved drop yard with many rows of parked trailers (100+ visible).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple warehouse buildings with extensive dock-door banks and trailers backed in on several faces; ~55 estimated, 50+ band confident, exact count low confidence.
fieldNotes.scale: Truck scale expected at this trucking volume; not separately resolved overhead — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound raw material/chemicals and outbound finished tissue handled from distinct warehouse/dock clusters on different building faces.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: One main confirmed entrance gate; the 640-acre campus may have a secondary gate (counted 1, flagged uncertain).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and ample paved/graded space at the gate and drop yard provide room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Mill sits on the edge of Muskogee along the Arkansas River with large open-field buffers and farmland/river beyond. Rural (small-city industrial edge).
